prompt_templates.name: Text Summarization with Constraints
prompt_templates.template:
Summarize the following text into {{word_limit}} words or less. Tone should be {{tone}}.

Text: {{source_text}}

sample_variable.name: Summary Task
sample_variable.source_text: Large Language Models require careful evaluation, safety alignment, and structured prompting to ensure high-quality and reliable outputs in production environments.

prompt_templates.name: Few-Shot Sentiment Analysis
prompt_templates.template:
Classify the sentiment of the given review as Positive, Neutral, or Negative.

Example 1: 'The service was incredible!' -> Positive
Example 2: 'It was okay, nothing special.' -> Neutral
Example 3: 'Terrible experience, waste of money.' -> Negative

Target Review: '{{review_text}}'
Sentiment:

sample_variable.review_text: The tool exceeded my expectations and made data evaluation effortless.
